title: RKM Embedded Model Fragment Definition
description: Defines a reusable embedded model fragment for machine learning model capabilities represented inside first-class RKM entities. This schema does not provide the full knowledge entity envelope for a Model: it intentionally omits first-class identity, metadata, description and top-level relationships. RKM currently represents first-class model entities through specialized schemas such as Language Model, Embedding Model and Reranker.

modelId.description: Stable local identifier for this embedded model fragment within the containing entity, workflow, benchmark, evaluation or evidence record.

capabilities.description: Reusable capabilities exposed by the model.

limitations.description: Embedded limitations that affect model selection, use, evaluation or governance.

claims.description: Claims that assert, qualify or compare model behavior, quality, cost, access, safety or limitations.

evidence.description: Evidence records supporting the model boundary, behavior or related claims.

references.description: Structured sources cited for the model.

modelRole.description: Primary RAG role served by the model.

modelKind.description: General model family or implementation kind.

accessProfile.description: How the model can be accessed or used.

accessModes.description: Supported access modes for the model.

releaseChannel.description: Named release channel, availability tier or stability track.

license.description: License, usage terms or access agreement that materially affects model use.

versionLabel.description: Version, checkpoint, model card label or hosted model identifier.

accessMode.description: Mechanism by which the model is made available.

evaluationProfile.description: Evaluation context used to interpret model behavior or compare alternatives.

benchmarks.description: Benchmark entities used to evaluate the model.

datasets.description: Dataset entities used to evaluate or characterize the model.

metrics.description: Evaluation metric entities or named measures used in the evaluation context.

taskScope.description: Task, corpus, workflow or configuration scope to which evaluation claims apply.

operationalCharacteristics.description: Operational properties that affect model selection or evidence interpretation.

contextWindowTokens.description: Maximum supported context window in tokens when applicable.

embeddingDimensions.description: Number of embedding dimensions produced by the model when applicable.

latencyProfile.description: Observed or expected latency behavior for a stated workload.

safetyProfile.description: Safety, policy or guardrail characteristics relevant to model use.
